summary: Converts a screen y-coordinate a2 into a list item index using layout parameters from the object at this: (a2 - horizontal_offset(0x13C) - column_offset(0x134) - start(0x4)) / item_height(0x158) + scroll_offset(0x14C), truncating with CRTFtol, then clamps the result within scroll bounds and, when a3 is set, within visible-page and total-item-count bounds.

local_names.a3: flag enabling page and item-count clamping

operations.description: Load item height this[86] (offset 0x158); if it is not greater than 0, return -1 without computing an index.
Check the vertical range: a2 must be greater than this[1] (offset 0x4) and less than this[2] (offset 0x8); otherwise return -1.
Compute the raw index as CRTFtol((a2 - this[79] - this[77] - this[1]) / item_height + this[83]), i.e. truncate the distance from the layout start divided by item height, offset by the scroll offset.
Clamp the result up to the scroll offset this[83] (0x14C): if result < scroll offset, set result = scroll offset.
When a3 is set, clamp the result to at most this[89] (0x164) + scroll offset - 1, and if result >= this[37] (0x94, total item count) return this[37] - 1.
Return the computed and clamped index, or -1 when the range or item-height guards fail.
